column1: # Guitar Rig 6 cabinet components, headless, impulse of amplitude 0.1 at 0.1 s (imp48.wav etc. from evidence/tonex_rates.tsv header). Run in $RE_STATE/work/cab/gr6bb.
# setup: $RE_STATE/bin/auhost state aufx 'Ni$R' -NI- gr6_default.aupreset ; python3 -I evidence/bb/ngrc_xml.py '<Component Presets>/<Name>/<Name> Factory.ngrc' ngrc_<Name>

# python3 evidence/bb/gr6cab.py mc|crp|other -> per row: python3 evidence/bb/gr6cabstate.py gr6_default.aupreset ngrc_<Name>_doc0.xml '<Name>' st_<tag>.aupreset <id>=<v>... Rack.G=0 ; auhost render aufx 'Ni$R' -NI- imp48.wav o_<tag>.wav --state st_<tag>.aupreset --tail 0.5 --warmup 2
# mc_* = Matched Cabinet (preset AC Box; c = Crossfade, a = Air, Cab = Cabinet, MV = Master Volume, st = Stereo); mc_off = component switched off (the empty-rack reference)

# crp_* = Control Room Pro (factory doc 0; s1 = Solo 1, ph1 = Phase 1, pi1 = PhaseInv 1, g1 = Gain 1, p1 = Pan 1, b = Bass); cr_init = Control Room INIT; cm_init = Cabinets & Mics INIT (passes the signal unchanged: no cab active in that state)
# onset = first sample above 1 % of peak, ipk = peak index, counted from the input impulse; t60 = samples until the remaining energy is 60 dB down; <f>Hz = 1/6-octave power average, dB
# Control Room Pro, Phase 1 = 0.25: delay 0.62 samples at 48 kHz (0.04 m / 343.2 m/s * 48000 * phase = 1.40)
# Control Room Pro, Phase 1 = 0.5: delay 2.19 samples at 48 kHz (0.04 m / 343.2 m/s * 48000 * phase = 2.80)
# Control Room Pro, Phase 1 = 1: delay 5.44 samples at 48 kHz (0.04 m / 343.2 m/s * 48000 * phase = 5.59)
# empty rack (component off): energy centroid 16.0 samples, peak index 16
